content.title: Project Hail Mary OTT release date details: When and where to watch Ryan Gosling's hit sci-fi movie
content.text: The sci-fi film Project Hail Mary has quietly built strong interest after its theatrical run, and now many viewers are waiting for when it will land on OTT. The movie, which released in Indian cinemas on March 26, has been pulling steady numbers and continues to stay in discussion, especially among fans of space-based survival stories.Based on Andy Weir’s bestselling novel, the film brings a mix of science, emotion, and a survival narrative that slowly unfolds. Directed by Phil Lord and Christopher Miller, the project has been mounted on a large scale and that shows in its presentation.Box office run and current responseThe film has managed to hold steady at the Indian box office even in its second week. After collecting around ₹29.50 crore in its first week, it continued to add numbers and reached close to ₹50 crore gross in India within 13 days. Reports suggest that on its second Tuesday alone, it brought in roughly ₹1.85 crore, taking the net total to about ₹41.40 crore.Globally too, the film has performed well and has been receiving strong reactions for its scale, visuals and overall storytelling approach. Early reviews have also worked in its favour, adding to the momentum.OTT release: Platform and expected dateAs of now, there is no official confirmation about the OTT release date of Project Hail Mary. However, since the film is backed by Amazon MGM Studios, the chances are quite strong that it will stream on Amazon Prime Video.Going by how most big Hollywood releases are handled these days, films usually arrive on OTT platforms somewhere between 45 to 90 days after their theatrical release. If the same pattern is followed here, the film could start streaming sometime between May and June 2026.There is also some talk around a staggered digital rollout. The film may first be made available on rent or for digital purchase by late April 2026, which is roughly 40 days after its cinema debut. After that, a full streaming release could follow in the weeks after.That said, the final timeline will depend heavily on how long the film continues to perform in theatres. If collections remain steady, the makers may push the OTT release further to maximise theatrical revenue.What the film is aboutThe story follows Ryland Grace, played by Ryan Gosling, who wakes up alone on a spaceship with no memory of how he got there. As things slowly come back to him, he realises that he is on a critical mission to save Earth from a mysterious threat that is affecting the sun.While trying to solve the problem, he comes across an unexpected ally, and that changes the course of his mission. The film mixes scientific problem-solving with emotional moments, making it more than just a space thriller.Apart from Ryan Gosling in the lead, the film also features Sandra Hüller as Eva Stratt. The supporting cast includes actors like Ken Leung, Milana Vayntrub, Lionel Boyce and Priya Kansara.
